'''María Cristina Pineda Suazo''' (1954) is a Honduran astronomer, physicist, civil engineer, professor, and scientific investigator. She was Director of the Astronomical Research Center (CEACS-UNAH), and currently serves as dean in the Faculty of Spatial Sciences (FACES) at the [[Universidad Nacional Autónoma de Honduras]]. She belongs to several scientific organizations, including the International Astronomical Union (IAU), the Asamblea de Astrónomos de América Central (AAAC), and the Fundación Salvador Moncada para el Avance de la Ciencia.<ref name=sirih.org>{{cite web|title=María Cristina Pineda Suazo|url=http://www.sirih.org/?nvs=64&title=Mar%EDa%20Cristina%20Pineda%20Suazo&lang=es|publisher=Secretaría Nacional de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación / Instituto Hondureño de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación / Departamento de Fomento a la Investigación Científica y Desarrollo Tecnológico|language=Spanish|accessdate=25 May 2015|archive-date=25 May 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150525074716/http://www.sirih.org/?nvs=64&title=Mar%EDa%20Cristina%20Pineda%20Suazo&lang=es|url-status=dead}}</ref> Pineda also serves as President of the National Committee for Astronomy in Honduras.<ref name=iau.org>{{cite web|title=Maria Cristina Pineda de Carías|url=http://www.iau.org/administration/membership/individual/951/|publisher=[[International Astronomical Union]]|accessdate=25 May 2015|archive-date=25 May 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150525080438/http://www.iau.org/administration/membership/individual/951/|url-status=dead}}</ref>
